text:
sara_cs: Quick heads-up — AeonCorp dedicated pool go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final sync on quota plan, autoscale policy, and load test window. I put the current numbers in the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/aeoncorp/onboard

omar_cs: Got it. Customer asks for a cost buffer and wants autoscale not to scale above 4 nodes without manual approval. They're sensitive to spend.

mike_sre: We can enforce a hard cap on the pool (max_instances: 4) and keep a soft target at 3. Also recommend cooldown 5m to avoid flapping.

julia_eng: For perf targets: model x-ver1 running on 4xA100 equiv should sustain ~220 qps (50 token avg) with p95 ~350ms in our staging runs. That's what I used for the autoscale curve.

sara_cs: Good — can you paste the autoscale policy here so I can confirm with Aeon?

julia_eng: Sure — policy draft:
```
policy:
  metric: requests_per_minute
  thresholds:
    - target: 12000   # start scaling at ~200 rps total
      action: scale_up
      step: 1
  max_instances: 4
  min_instances: 1
  cooldown: 300s
```

mike_sre: Looks fine. I'll add alerting: instances > 3 for 15m -> page on-call, burst > 350 qps for 5m -> ops slack channel.

alice_ml: Reminder — warmup is important for this model. We'll pre-populate KV cache with top 200 prompt prefixes from their sample. Can we get that sample by EOD?

omar_cs: I'll ask them for the prompt set and a short list of high-cost queries. Also requesting the initial traffic profile.

ev an_prod: Suggest running a staged load test tomorrow morning before traffic shift: quick ramp plan below.

julia_eng: Here's the loadtest script we plan to run (wrk):
```bash
# staged ramp to validate autoscale and fallbacks
wrk -t8 -c200 -d15m https://dedicated.aeoncorp.internal/api/generate -s scripts/aeon_ramp.lua
# follow with full-run: 60m at target QPS (~220 qps)
wrk -t12 -c400 -d60m https://dedicated.aeoncorp.internal/api/generate -s scripts/aeon_steady.lua
```

sara_cs: Timeline idea: 07:30 PT - quick smoke, 08:30 PT - staged ramp, 09:00 PT - shift live (customer ready). Can we get 07:00 prep window for config flips?

mike_sre: 07:00 OK for infra flips. I'll coordinate with eng-oncall. deploy-bot: schedule canary at 07:30?

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 1749064200 — rollback window 07:50 PT.

julia_eng: One more operational note — if autoscale hits max_instances and latency rises, we'll fallback to smaller quantized variant (x-ver1-q4) automatically. Need customer's signoff on potential quality delta.

omar_cs: I'll get signoff in the enablement call at 16:00 PT today. Also flagging renewal risk: customer asked for performance guarantees for their upcoming RFP. We should capture test artifacts and perf numbers in the QBR doc.

sara_cs: Action items:
- omar_cs: collect prompt set + traffic profile (due EOD)
- julia_eng: finalize autoscale policy & load scripts (due tonight)
- mike_sre: add alerts and hard cap, schedule infra flips (done)
- alice_ml: run KV warmup after receiving prompt set
- evan_prod: prepare cost tradeoffs slide for enablement call

omar_cs: noted. I'll also ask them to join a 30m post-go-live check-in to capture feedback.

alice_ml: If they can share 100 sample sessions we can run evals+regression within 24h and report quality delta for q4 variant.

ev an_prod: I'll include a simple cost table showing tokens/sec vs. monthly cost — helps with renewals.

sara_cs: Perfect. Last Q: any known breaking issues from staging?

julia_eng: One flake where KV warmup script sometimes times out on first run; workaround is to run it twice or increase connect timeout to 10s. We'll patch but won't block tomorrow.

mike_sre: Acknowledged, I'll include that in runbook and monitor the first 30m for warmup errors.

omar_cs: Thanks all. I'll update Aeon with the plan and confirm the enablement call at 16:00. :thumbsup:

sara_cs: Thanks — will be on the post-go-live check at 10:00 PT. :rocket:
